Always on (automated): +1 to Larceny and Hide & Sneak checks.

Bonus Action (once per scene): your next Larceny and Hide & Sneak check before the end of your turn gains a further +1.

Reskin freely as training, a perk, an implant, a technique, a gadget or a power.
